scope: AOT Release simulator and emulator layout stress. CPU and memory are whole process. This is a comparison of the tested layout paths.

workload.update: On each platform frame callback change the first shape width between 8 and 10 logical units for every cell.
workload.control: Replace only the BenchCell Column call with centered VStack or centered Compose Column with the same gap. BenchCell has no labeled or safe area content.

platforms.ios: iPhone 18 Pro Max simulator, iOS 27.0, arm64; display link set to 60 Hz
platforms.android: emulator-5554, Android 12 API 31; 1080 x 2340; gfxinfo uses the last retained intended-vsync timestamps for completed frames; API duration includes queueing

geometryCheck.inheritedTextAlignment: trailing in both cases; nested children receive the false safe-area fill flag
